panels.description: Explains the incident-triage question and the evidence scopes used on this read-only dashboard. CURRENT ranks suspects from current fleet telemetry in GLOBAL scope; Pipeline and Run ID do not filter suspects. SELECTED RUN uses HTTP-backed evidence for one exact run; run_id never filters Prometheus. No suspects means none were found in the current scope and does not prove the fleet is healthy Run coverage: IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN. Set range to run when OUT OF RANGE. Effective refresh: 60s · timezone: browser. Effective filters: provider=${provider}.

options.content: GLOBAL fleet triage: Pipeline / Run ID do not filter suspects. Open the row’s domain and object; selected-run evidence is separate.

panels.title: Monitor Incident Status
panels.description: CURRENT · TIME RANGE · Pair with Provenance reason + action; never read as OK. Not a healthy OK. Ranked suspects may be WORKFLOW/GLOBAL blast radius — check scope labels on tables. Incident header status (labelled only). Map 0=OK,1=WARN,2=CRIT,3/null=UNKNOWN. Never bare numbers. Confidence from missing telemetry / VALID_EMPTY suspects. Read-only workspace

options.content: GLOBAL · CURRENT · Rank: CRIT before WARN; ties have equal urgency. Confidence: signal only, unverified cause. Impact / event age: UNKNOWN until verified.

panels.title: Inspect Ranked Suspects
panels.description: GLOBAL · CURRENT at query evaluation time (range end), not SELECTED RUN. Rank is severity order: CRIT=2, WARN=1, UNKNOWN=0; ties have equal urgency, not higher confidence. Confidence is UNVERIFIED: a rule signal alone does not establish cause or impact. Pipeline/provider identifies potential impact scope; confirm with domain evidence. Only active (>0) signals are ranked; telemetry_gap stays UNKNOWN. VALID EMPTY means no active suspects with available evidence; TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Domain details use the same GLOBAL scope and evaluation time. Rule sample time is not the underlying event time. Inspect retains source labels; Action preserves row scope. TIME RANGE selects evaluation time, not an event-history rank.

panels.title: Monitor Current Alerts
panels.description: CURRENT · Do not put full UUIDs into Prometheus labels. Instant ALERTS snapshot (firing/pending). Pair with Alert State History as one temporal chain. VALID_EMPTY when none VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING.

defaults.noValue: EMPTY DOMAIN — no active suspects. Not a healthy-fleet verdict; require Status/Telemetry Presence first.

panels.title: Track Alert State History
panels.description: GLOBAL · TIME RANGE · ALERTS history, not a persistent incident log. FIRING/PENDING legend names the states; adjacent equal samples merge. Auto labels avoid clipped fragments. Hover a band for full alert name and interval start/end; gaps remain gaps. VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING. Outlined intervals use semantic state colors; hover for exact interval boundaries. Gaps mean no observed samples, not OK. State is explicit in the full row label and legend; narrow intervals carry no clipped in-band text.

options.content: Impact: confirm the row’s pipeline/provider. Confidence: UNVERIFIED until domain status and independent evidence agree. UNKNOWN means missing telemetry; it does not identify a cause.

panels.title: Review Selected Run Summary
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Compact pipeline_run_report_v1 projection (identity, times, gold out, contract exclusions, coverage). Missing run is VALID EMPTY / SELECT RUN, not OK. Set range to run opens 6. Run Explorer at started_at-5m .. completed_at+5m. Do not treat CURRENT Prometheus as this UUID. Backend unavailable means the query could not be evaluated. Verify /health/live. Coverage chip is IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN from covers_selected_run. Set range to run opens Run Explorer 3022 at from_ms..to_ms. A covered run does not show an outside-range warning. Status, coverage and local timestamps precede the UUID. Inspect the Run cell to copy its complete value; range-bound fields remain available to the Set range to run action and panel data inspection.
